about_the_game:
🌯 Serve Turkey’s Spiciest Wraps in Your Own Shop!

Master of Çiğköfte puts you in charge of a Turkish street food restaurant!
Wrap up pre-made çiğköfte, add sauces, drinks, and packaging — and keep customers happy! 👨‍🍳🥤

🫓 Wrap & Serve:
Place çiğköfte in lavaş, drizzle sauces, add garnishes, pack with napkins and drinks!

📦 Buy Items Like Bags, Straws, Napkins:
Each item helps you perfect your delivery.

🧊 Unlock a Drink Fridge:
Upgrade your menu with cold beverage options.

🎨 Customize Your Shop:
Change your wall & counter designs, hang your own photo, and earn your business certificate!

💡 Unlock Functional Items:
Earn money and unlock new systems like the scale (tartı) for expanding your workflow — not for delivery, but for production efficiency!

💸 Pay Daily Rent:
Manage your income wisely or risk losing it all!

🤫 Mysterious Visitors:
Not every customer comes for food — choose wisely.

🎮 A vibrant, fast-paced first-person simulator full of Turkish flavor and charm!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Discover the spicy world of çiğköfte, Turkey’s famous bulgur-based street food! Wrap it in lavaş, serve customers, upgrade your food shop, and become a street food legend in this fun, colorful first-person cooking simulator.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian
